# RAD-Scorpions: You can find them here

![RAD scorpions: You can find them here](/uploads/301_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**RAD Scorpions** are large mutated scorpions that also often burrow underground. Their attacks also come from the ground. When they spot you, they hide under the ground and then attack you from below.

## RAD Scorpions in these locations:

- Smith Farm (4 RAD Scorpions)
- Sometimes in Knife Edge
- Sometimes in the dry riverbed in Toxic Valley at Lakeside Grill
- Sometimes at Grainiger Farm
- Sometimes at the Freak Show
- Sometimes in Whitespring in the garden between the resort and the golf course
- Sometimes at the Kiddie Corner cabins
- (During and after the Wastelanders Quest) 5 RAD Scorpions in the Carleton Mine

![RAD scorpions at Smith Farm](/uploads/nukaknights-post-rad-scorpions-smith-farm-fallout-76-2024-02-08-17-22-48.jpg) 

## RAD scorpions at events

- Healthy and Safe
- Scorched earth
- The wheel
- Stories around the campfire

You can also find out more about RAD scorpions in the wiki.
